user.title: Matpriskollen
user.description: Choose the stores to follow. Their pages on matpriskollen.se list this week's offers and are read at most once per update interval. Add products afterwards with **Add product**.

data_description.cities: Comma-separated, e.g. Tyresö, Haninge. All stores in these towns are listed in the next step.
data_description.store_links: Optional. Links to store pages, e.g. matpriskollen.se/butiker/coop-tyreso--….
data_description.update_hours: Offers change once a week, so once a day (24) is enough. At least 6.

stores.title: Choose stores
stores.description: {count} stores found. Choose the ones to follow.

error.bad_link: A store link should look like matpriskollen.se/butiker/name--id.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read matpriskollen.se. Try again later.
error.no_stores: No stores found. Enter towns or store links.

user.title: Add product
user.description: Follow a product in your stores.

data_description.name: Brand or product name as written in the offer, e.g. Celsius or Nocco.
data_description.max_price: You get a notification when a store sells it for this or less per item (for example 3 for 36 kr = 12 kr each). Leave empty to be told about every offer.
data_description.notify: Devices or services that get the notification. Leave empty for no notification.
